changes.text: 本文全部史实出自《清史稿·左宗棠传》一处传记，成书刊行远在事件之后，是单一史源。本文未查阅同时期奏疏原文、上谕原件，也未查阅李鸿章、帕夏、俄方、崇厚一方的记载以作对勘；传中所引奏疏、诏书为史家转引，未必是全文。文中的宗棠曰、歎曰，以及那道令曰，都是史家记述，未必是逐字原话；英文版中的引语均为作者自文言译出。文祥独善宗棠议、李鸿章言之尤力各只有一句，未记具体论据，本文没有替任何一方补写心理动机。

Every fact here comes from a single source: the biography of Zuo Zongtang in the Draft History of the Qing, compiled and printed long after the events it describes. This piece did not consult original memorials, edict originals, or accounts by Li Hongzhang, Pasha, the Russian side or Chong Hou to check against it; the memorial and edict wording quoted in the biography comes to us through the compilers and is not necessarily complete. The "Zuo said," "Zuo sighed," and the general order are the historian's rendering and need not be verbatim. All quotations in the English text are the author's translations from the classical Chinese. Wenxiang's support and Li Hongzhang's advocacy each appear in a single sentence, without their arguments, and no motive is written in for either.
全文仅据《清史稿·左宗棠传》单一史源，成书远晚于事件；本文未查阅同期奏疏、上谕原件或对方记载以作对勘，传中所引奏、诏为史家转引，未必是全文；引语为史家记述，未必逐字，英文版引语为作者译文；数字照录、口径不详；纪年不换算公元；「帕夏畏俄逼」为原文表述；替代选择与现代场景均为作者所加。

Everything rests on a single source, the biography of Zuo Zongtang in the Draft History of the Qing, compiled long after the events; this piece did not consult original memorials, edicts or opposing accounts to check against it, and the memorials and edicts quoted in the biography come through the compilers and are not necessarily complete. Quotations are the historian's rendering and may not be verbatim, and English quotations are the author's translations; numbers are reproduced as written, with scope unstated; dates are not converted out of the Guangxu reign years; "Pasha feared Russian pressure" is the source's own phrasing; and the modern scenes and the alternative option are the author's additions.

dispositions.rationale: 原句断言同期奏疏、上谕和对方记载“没有”，证据包无法支持。中英文都改为只说明本文未查阅这些材料。同时注明传中已引用奏疏和诏书，但这些是经史家转引的文字，未必是全文。该段其余句子不变。
按 F1 的方式同步修改中英文：把“无……可作对勘”改为“本文未查阅……以作对勘”，并补注传中所引奏、诏为史家转引，未必是全文。其余限定语保持原样。
